goal: 修复已有项目中失败的测试，并生成修复报告
purpose: Validate verification failure handling, debug repair, backup creation, correctness-gate rejection of the failing baseline, and final reporting.
expected_capabilities: Rejects the failing baseline via the correctness gate (blocked task_execution_evidence, contract not ok) instead of accepting it as done.
Creates backups for modified files before writing.
acceptance: The fixture test fails before repair.
The fixture test passes after repair.
At least one backup manifest is created for the modified source file.
Final report lists the repaired artifact.
recommended_command: asteria /run "修复已有项目中失败的测试，并生成修复报告" --root <workspace>
